briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with new model releases from major labs driving capability leaps. Funding surges past $11B quarterly while regulatory pressure mounts on alignment. Multi-agent systems expose fresh attack surfaces.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced chain-of-thought reasoning; Anthropic launches Claude 4.5 claiming 35% gains on agent benchmarks. Google DeepMind previews Gemini 3 preview and Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. xAI Colossus cluster trains Grok-3 at scale.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 50GW data center expansions; TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips with Nvidia Blackwell shortages persisting. Oracle and CoreWeave sign $3B GPU cloud deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will scaling laws hold through 2027 or will inference-time compute shift the AGI timeline?
